ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the gripper body for cracks, dents, or deformation at jaw mounting faces. 2. Check the actuator housing for impact damage or distortion. 3. Inspect the jaw slide channel for scoring or material loss.

turns.utterance: All three checks completed. The gripper body, actuator housing, and slide channel have been inspected.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the gripper body for cracks, dents, or deformation at jaw mounting faces. 2. Check the actuator housing for impact damage or distortion. 3. Inspect the jaw slide channel for scoring or material loss.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is structural damage present on the gripper body?

ground_truth.node_text: Structural damage present on gripper body?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No structural damage detected. The gripper body, actuator housing, and slide channels all appear intact with no cracks, dents, or deformation.

ground_truth.node_text: Structural damage present on gripper body?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is jaw insert wear within tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw insert wear within tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the jaw insert thickness measurements are all above the minimum serviceable threshold. Wear is distributed evenly across the contact faces.

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw insert wear within tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the gripping force within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Gripping force within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, gripping force readings at both fifty percent and one hundred percent pressure fall within the specified minimum and maximum values.

ground_truth.node_text: Gripping force within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is jaw alignment within positional tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw alignment within positional tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the measurements show the jaw position is outside the permitted tolerance at the secondary locating surfaces.

ground_truth.node_text: Jaw alignment within positional tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Realign the jaw mounting using the precision alignment jig.

ground_truth.node_text: Realign jaw mounting using precision alignment jig

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Jaw mounting has been realigned using the precision jig and secured.

ground_truth.node_text: Realign jaw mounting using precision alignment jig

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: With the fixture open, visually inspect the jaw pivot pins and guide rails for dry running, corrosion, or swarf accumulation. Apply a thin film of the specified grease to each pivot pin and run the jaw through three full open and close cycles to distribute lubricant evenly. Wipe away any excess from the part contact surfaces.

ground_truth.node_text: With the fixture open, visually inspect the jaw pivot pins and guide rails for dry running, corrosion, or swarf accumulation. Apply a thin film of the specified grease to each pivot pin and run the jaw through three full open and close cycles to distribute lubricant evenly. Wipe away any excess from the part contact surfaces.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Pivot pins and guide rails inspected, grease applied, and three cycles completed. Excess lubricant has been wiped from contact surfaces.

ground_truth.node_text: With the fixture open, visually inspect the jaw pivot pins and guide rails for dry running, corrosion, or swarf accumulation. Apply a thin film of the specified grease to each pivot pin and run the jaw through three full open and close cycles to distribute lubricant evenly. Wipe away any excess from the part contact surfaces.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the lubrication level and condition adequate?

ground_truth.node_text: Lubrication level and condition adequate?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the pivot pins still show signs of dry running and need additional lubrication.

ground_truth.node_text: Lubrication level and condition adequate?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply lubricant to the pivot pins per the lubrication chart.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply lubricant to pivot pins per lubrication chart

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Lubricant applied to all pivot pins according to the chart specifications.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply lubricant to pivot pins per lubrication chart

turns.utterance: Log this maintenance activity and update the maintenance management system service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log maintenance and update maintenance management system service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing some unusual vibration patterns in the bearing housing that weren't there before, but I'm not sure if I should document that anywhere or if it needs immediate attention.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Maintenance logged and service record updated in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log maintenance and update maintenance management system service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The gripper fixture has passed all diagnostic checks and is ready to return to service.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, fixture is cleared for production.
